card.summary: 1 GiB of KV storage on Free. Pricing page, KV section: 'KV storage: 1 GiB'; 'KV read units/mo (4KiB): 1,000,000'; 'KV write units/mo (1KiB): 500,000'. Pro ra...

free_tier.stated: 1 GiB of KV storage on Free. Pricing page, KV section: 'KV storage: 1 GiB'; 'KV read units/mo (4KiB): 1,000,000'; 'KV write units/mo (1KiB): 500,000'. Pro raises KV to 5 GiB. Deployment assets are separately capped: 'the total size of all files within the deployment (source files and static files) should not exceed 1 gigabyte' and Free includes 'Revision storage: 10 GiB'.

egress.terms: Free tier includes 20 GiB per month metered egress bandwidth across deployments and 1 million requests per month.

record.tooling: `Deno.Kv` API in-runtime; `@deno/kv` client; remote access via the URL connector (`https://api.deno.com/v2/databases/<id>/connect`). No HTTP object endpoint. Every read must go through your own code.
record.chaining: 10 apps per organization on Free, but KV storage is 1 GiB per organization, not per app, so extra apps buy nothing. 1 GiB x N organizations requires N billing identities for 20 TiB. 20,000 accounts. Dead.
record.limits_note: 1 GiB KV, 1M read units/mo, 500K write units/mo, 20 GiB egress, 1M requests, 10 apps, 1 concurrent build, 15 builds/hour. Deployment bundle <= 1 GB. 512 MB memory. KV data is stored in and transits the US.
record.reliability_note: Durable once written, but 'Deleting a Deno KV database instance ... deletes all existing Deno KV databases and their data' — a single DELETE wipes every KV database in the org, which is a sharp edge. Free-plan service is in public beta with no uptime guarantee.
